items.text: pythonclass ModelTree((max_depth=6, min_rows=15, minsplit=None, minbucket=None, minprob=0.02, max_leaf_nodes=None, min_gain=1e-09, purity_gate=None, purity_gate_metric='sd', tail_quantile=None, gain=None, split_precision=Ellipsis, split_cols=None, col_sample=None, seed=42, leaf='linear', tau=0.5, l1=0.0, l2=0.5, leaf_cols='all', leaf_digest=True, cat_order=None, cat_search='cumulative', monotone=Ellipsis, tree_monotone=None, leaf_monotone=None, col_weights=None, interaction_groups=None, alpha=0.0, imbalance_penalty=0.0, prune='cp', cp_alpha=5.0, honesty=False, honesty_fraction=0.5, maxsurrogate=0, split_test='none', split_alpha=0.05, bonferroni=False, preselect='none', min_relevance=None, verbose=0, leaf_family='gaussian', leaf_solver='lbfgs', split_eval='fast', presort=False, events=None, treatments=None, train_groups=True, train_ids=False, n_classes=None, tweedie_p=1.5, tobit_threshold=0.0, mars_degree=1, mars_terms=10, mars_penalty=2.0, knn_k=5, knn_k_validity=5, knn_variant='uniform', knn_metric='euclidean', knn_gamma=None, knn_p=2.0, shrinkage=0.0, max_classes=256, leaf_na_policy='drop_fallback', preset=None, control=None, leaf_control=None, mmd_kernel=None, mmd_bandwidth=None, fairness_penalty=None, protected_col=None, fairness_metric=None, sporf_d=0, sporf_projections=10, extratrees=False, ebm_fast=False)) Model tree: greedy splits with Gaussian, binomial-logit or Poisson-log leaves, NA-aware (learned split directions + NA-indicator leaf terms). Task: regression, binary probability estimation, or count modeling.

items.title: ModelTree.apply
items.text:
pythonapply((self, /, x)) Return the leaf ID (0..n_leaves-1) for each input row.

Args: x: raw rows of predictors.

Returns: one integer leaf ID per row.

items.title: ModelTree.break_down
items.text:
pythonbreak_down((self, /, row)) DALEX-style break-down of one response-scale prediction.

Args: row: one row of predictors (None = missing). Accepts mixed numeric and categorical strings.

Returns: {"baseline", "steps": [[column_name, contribution], ...], "residual", "prediction"}; baseline + steps + residual == prediction.

items.title: ModelTree.cdf
items.text:
pythoncdf((self, /, x, value)) Fitted binomial/Poisson CDF P(Y <= value), conditional on each row.

Args: x: raw rows of predictors, with the same missing/level handling as predict. value: response threshold; discrete CDFs use its integer floor.

Returns: one fitted-distribution probability per row. Unlike quantile, this uses the fitted family, not the empirical target t-digest.

Raises: ValueError for Gaussian leaves or an invalid threshold.

items.title: ModelTree.extract_rules
items.text: pythonextract_rules((self, /, x=None, y=None, prune=True, cf=0.25)) Extract a C5.0-style rule set from this fitted tree.

items.title: ModelTree.fast_interactions
items.text: pythonfast_interactions((self, /)) Returns list of detected pairwise feature interactions from EBM FAST screening.

items.title: ModelTree.feature_importance
items.text: pythonfeature_importance((self, /, method='gain', x=None, y=None, metric=None, n_repeats=None, seed=None)) Feature importance — supports "gain" (default, rpart split gain share), "shapley" (mean absolute TreeSHAP over rows), or "permutation" (score degradation).

items.title: ModelTree.fit
items.text:
pythonfit((self, /, x, y, w=None, dtypes=None, control=None, id_col=None, group_col=None, col_names=None, event=None, treatment=None, n_classes=None, sample_weight=None, row_weights=None, col_weights=None, feature_weights=None, train_groups=None, train_ids=None, fairness_penalty=None, protected_col=None, protected_attribute=None, fairness_metric=None, sporf_d=None, sporf_projections=None, extratrees=None, ebm_fast=None)) Fit the tree on row-major data using the selected leaf family.

Args: x: rows of predictors; None entries are missing (NA rows train). y: targets; None/NaN drops that row for binomial/Poisson. Gaussian NaN handling follows the historical Gaussian path. Binomial targets are 0 or 1; Poisson targets are finite nonnegative counts or rates (including fractional values). Gaussian targets retain ordinary regression. w: optional per-row sample weights (row weightage); zero-weight rows are ignored. dtypes: optional per-column types — "numeric" (default) or "categorical" (values are level codes; the split search partitions levels, no encoding).

Returns: nothing; the fitted tree replaces the inner model.

items.title: ModelTree.get_params
items.text: pythonget_params((self, /, deep=True)) Return all hyperparameter values as a dict (scikit-learn compatible).

items.title: ModelTree.leaf_samples
items.text:
pythonleaf_samples((self, /, x, id_col=None, col_names=None)) Return row indices or entity IDs grouped by leaf ID: {leaf_id: [indices_or_ids]}.

Args: x: raw rows of predictors. id_col: optional column name, column index, or list of IDs. If None (default), returns integer row indices [0, 1, ...]. If provided, returns the corresponding entity ID values. col_names: optional data column names when x has different layout than training data.

Returns: dict mapping integer leaf_id to a list of row indices or entity IDs.

items.title: ModelTree.leaf_stats
items.text: pythonleaf_stats((self, /)) Return the list of 0D stats dictionaries for all leaves.

items.title: ModelTree.leaf_summary
items.text: pythonleaf_summary((self, /, leaf_id)) Format a leaf's regression model as an R summary(lm) / Python statsmodels table.

items.title: ModelTree.leaves
items.text:
pythonleaves((self, /)) Fitted leaf models with their empirical target distribution stats.

Args: none.

Returns: one dict per leaf with cols, coef, na_coef, intercept, response_constant, n, mean, std, min, max, quantiles. Linear coef, na_coef, and intercept use the family's link scale (identity, logit, or log); mean and other stats describe raw targets. Constant leaves have no link-scale coefficient vector: intercept is None, while response_constant is the response-scale constant.

items.title: ModelTree.n_leaves
items.text:
pythonn_leaves((self, /)) Number of leaves.

Args: none.

Returns: leaf count.

items.title: ModelTree.permutation_importance
items.text: pythonpermutation_importance((self, /, x, y, metric='rmse', n_repeats=5, seed=42)) Permutation feature importance: per-column validation loss degradation when the column is shuffled across rows.

items.title: ModelTree.predict
items.text: pythonpredict((self, /, x, kind='response', times=None, neighbors=None)) Predict with flexible output kinds: kind="response" (default): expected value / class / median survival time. kind="proba": class probabilities ((N, C) matrix for Softmax, 1D float list for Binomial/Probit). kind="dist": (mean, std) location-scale tuples for Heteroscedastic. kind="survival": S(t) survival curve over times grid. kind="hazard": Lambda(t) cumulative hazard curve over times grid. kind="leaf_id": integer leaf ID per row.

items.title: ModelTree.predict_adjusted
items.text: pythonpredict_adjusted((self, /, x, neighbors=5)) Predict with Cubist-style k-NN sample neighbor adjustment.

items.title: ModelTree.predict_interval
items.text:
pythonpredict_interval((self, /, x, coverage=0.9)) Empirical prediction interval (lower, upper) per row at the requested coverage.

Args: x: raw rows of predictors. coverage: coverage probability in (0, 1) (default 0.90 for a 90% interval).

Returns: list of (lower, upper) tuples.

items.title: ModelTree.predict_label
items.text:
pythonpredict_label((self, /, x, threshold=0.5)) Hard binary class labels (0 or 1), one label per input row.

Args: x: raw rows of predictors. threshold: probability threshold (default 0.5).

Returns: one integer label (0 or 1) per row.

Raises: ValueError unless the fitted leaf family is binomial.

items.title: ModelTree.predict_proba
items.text: pythonpredict_proba((self, /, x)) Predict class probabilities (convenience alias for predict(x, kind="proba")).

items.title: ModelTree.predict_vector
items.text: pythonpredict_vector((self, /, x)) Predict multi-dimensional vector targets for row-major x (when trained on vector targets).

items.title: ModelTree.profile
items.text:
pythonprofile((self, /)) Per-level timing profile (group/sort, scan, leaf fit).

Args: none.

Returns: one dict per depth level with depth, nodes, rows, cols, candidates, group_ns, scan_ns, leaf_ns.

items.title: ModelTree.quantile
items.text:
pythonquantile((self, /, x, tau)) Empirical conditional target quantiles from the leaves' t-digests: any tau in [0, 1] after fitting. These are not quantiles of the fitted binomial/Poisson distribution; use cdf for that distribution's CDF.

Args: x: rows of predictors (NA never blocks). tau: quantile level.

Returns: one quantile per row (NaN when a leaf's digest was dropped).

items.title: ModelTree.retrain
items.text:
pythonretrain((self, /, x, y, control=None, w=None, mode='internal', leaf_features=None, retrain_cols=None, col_names=None, leaf=None, leaf_family=None, leaf_cols=None, l1=None, l2=None, leaf_digest=None, tau=None, event=None, n_classes=None)) Retrain all leaf models on new or existing data without altering tree topology or splits.

Args: x: rows of predictors; None entries are missing. y: targets. control: optional LeafControl instance or dict. w: optional sample weights. mode: "internal" (updates self in place and returns self) or "external" (returns new ModelTree clone). leaf_features: optional subset of column indices or names for leaf models. retrain_cols: alias for leaf_features. col_names: optional data column names to validate and remap splits. leaf: optional leaf kind override ("linear", "mean", "median", "quantile", "huber"). leaf_family: optional leaf distribution override ("gaussian", "binomial", "poisson"). leaf_cols: optional leaf columns policy override ("all", "path_used"). l1: optional lasso penalty override. l2: optional ridge penalty override. leaf_digest: optional bool whether to keep leaf t-digests. tau: optional quantile tau when leaf is "quantile" (default 0.5).

Returns: updated ModelTree (self for internal mode, or new ModelTree for external mode).

items.title: ModelTree.root_split
items.text: pythonroot_split((self, /)) Root node split, if the tree split at the root.

items.title: ModelTree.shapley
items.text: pythonshapley((self, /, row)) Exact TreeSHAP feature attributions for a single row prediction: efficiency invariant: base_value + \sum values == prediction.

items.title: ModelTree.split_diagnostics
items.text: pythonsplit_diagnostics((self, /)) Statistical split diagnostics per node (MOB / Chow / CTree hypothesis tests). Returns a list of dicts with test name, statistic, p-value, alpha, passed flag, and per-variable test results.

items.title: ModelTree.split_paths
items.text:
pythonsplit_paths((self, /)) Split columns along each root-to-leaf path.

Args: none.

Returns: one list of column names per root-to-leaf path (the split columns on that path) — the introspection behind interaction-group checking.

items.title: ModelTree.splits
items.text:
pythonsplits((self, /)) Learned splits.

Args: none.

Returns: one dict per split with col, threshold, missing_left, gain (goodness of split).

items.title: ModelTree.summary
items.text: pythonsummary((self, /)) Print comprehensive summary of all leaf models across the tree.

items.title: ModelTree.to_dot
items.text: pythonto_dot((self, /)) Graphviz DOT for the tree (render with pygraphviz/graphviz — layout is graphviz's job): pgv.AGraph(string=model.to_dot()).draw("tree.svg", prog="dot").

items.title: ModelTree.training_log
items.text:
pythontraining_log((self, /)) The training log (populated when verbose > 0): scan config, per depth/per node candidate counts, precision grid, timings.

Args: none.

Returns: log lines.
